summary: Menlo Engineering Associates is a civil engineering and landscape architecture consultancy founded in 1966 and based at 261 Cleveland Avenue in Highland Park, NJ, billing itself as having completed 3,000+ planning and design projects for developers, retailers, institutions and municipalities across New Jersey. Work is won through relationships, municipal-board appearances and referrals rather than an online funnel: the site offers a phone number and a four-field contact form, with no quote engine, booking, portal or client login. Its public web presence is thin and partly broken (home page with no heading and one paragraph, Projects and News indexes rendering raw page-builder code), even though the firm posted a new project announcement in June 2026 and is recruiting two senior engineering roles.

facts.fact: Office address is 261 Cleveland Avenue, Highland Park, NJ 08904; main phone 732-846-8585; fax 732-846-9439.

Company says it was established in 1966 by John J. Zimmerman and has 'over 3,000 planning & design projects to our credit', spanning commercial, industrial and residential site plans plus public improvements.
Six service lines are published: Site Engineering, Land Planning, Landscape Architecture, Wetland & Environmental, Highway Design and Construction Administration.

Careers page carries two open Highland Park positions, Project Engineering Designer ($75k-$90k, AutoCAD Civil 3D, NJDEP stormwater rules) and Project Manager P.E. ($120K-$135K), with resumes directed to a named firm email address.

WordPress REST API shows the careers page last modified 2026-03-03, the leadership page 2026-05-12 and the site-engineering page 2026-05-04, while the home page was last modified 2024-04-25 and the contact page 2024-05-17.

Latest news post (June 26, 2026) congratulates Greek Real Estate Partners on a 281,215-SF Class A industrial facility at 169 Lackawanna Avenue, Parsippany, with completion anticipated early 2027 and Menlo on the design team.

Rendered home page has no h1 element, about 431 characters of visible text (one paragraph), one image, and JSON-LD limited to BreadcrumbList, Organization, WebPage and WebSite with a telephone but no address and no LocalBusiness/ProfessionalService type.

Projects index and News index render the page-builder shortcode as literal text on the page, so no projects or news items are displayed to visitors; the Project Map page contains only an empty iframe container.

Google Maps limited view shows 'Menlo Engineering Associates Inc', rated 5.0, categorised 'Civil engineer', at 261 Cleveland Ave with phone and status 'Closed - Opens 8:30 AM Mon'; no review count is displayed in that view.
Third-party local listing shows 5.0 from 3 reviews with hours Mon-Fri 8:30 a.m.-5:00 p.m., closed Saturday and Sunday; the reviews displayed are dated about 8 years and 12 years ago.

Leadership page names Gregory S. Oman as President / Principal Engineer, William Lane as EVP, and Kenneth Grisewood, Scott Turner and Robert Gill as Vice Presidents, plus six 'Key Personnel' project managers and a landscape architect.
Firm announcement names Oman, Lane, Turner, Grisewood and Gill as company officers, notes Oman as President, and says Fred Coco and Jule Szalay moved to part-time advisory roles ahead of retirement.

Client list page names a long roster of developers, retailers, institutions and municipalities, including Costco, Home Depot, Toll Brothers, K. Hovnanian, Stop & Shop, Rutgers University, Middlesex County and Piscataway Township, and carries one short client testimonial.

Riverdale Planning Board minutes of November 13, 2025 record 'Scott Turner of Menlo Engineering Associates' being sworn in as the first expert for application 2025-11, 79 Newark Pompton Turnpike / 130 Main Street, LLC.
robots.txt disallows only /wp-admin/ and publishes sitemap.xml and sitemap.rss, so crawlers and AI agents are not otherwise restricted.

operations_signals: Front door is a published phone number (732-846-8585) plus a four-field contact form (Name, Email, Phone, Message) on the Contact Us page; there is no online quote, booking, scheduling or file-upload path for new project inquiries (https://menloeng.com/contact-us/)
Phone is plain text on the home page with no tel: link and no call-to-action above the fold; the click-to-call tel: link appears only on inner pages (https://menloeng.com/)

Stated public hours are Monday-Friday 8:30 a.m.-5:00 p.m., closed weekends; nothing published about after-hours, emergency or storm-response coverage for construction-phase work (https://reviews.birdeye.com/menlo-engineering-associates-inc-144684430385065)
Contact form is Gravity Forms with reCAPTCHA v3 and a honeypot field, so an automated agent has to clear a bot check before submitting an inquiry (https://menloeng.com/contact-us/)

Job applicants are routed to a second Gravity Form with a 15 MB resume upload, and the postings also give a named firm email for resumes — two parallel intake paths to maintain (https://menloeng.com/our-company/careers/)

Recurring work includes sworn expert testimony at municipal planning and zoning boards on behalf of developer clients, which means scheduling coordination around board calendars (https://www.riverdalenj.gov/_Content/pdf/minutes/2025-11-13-PB-Minutes.pdf)

New project news is published (June 26, 2026 post) but the News index that should list it renders raw shortcode, so the firm's own recent work is not reachable from its menu (https://menloeng.com/news/)
hiring_signals: Open Project Engineering Designer role in Highland Park, $75k-$90k, requiring 5+ years of civil site design, AutoCAD Civil 3D, grading/drainage and NJDEP stormwater rules — production drafting and plan-preparation capacity (https://menloeng.com/our-company/careers/)

Open Project Manager P.E. role, $120K-$135K, requiring a P.E. with 5+ years managing site and subdivision plans through land-development approvals — the coordination and permit-chasing layer (https://menloeng.com/our-company/careers/)

A third posting (Engineering Technician / CADD Designer-Drafter) still exists in the page markup but is disabled, which suggests a recurring or rolling drafting-seat requirement rather than a one-off hire (https://menloeng.com/wp-json/wp/v2/pages?per_page=30&_fields=slug,modified,link)

Careers page was edited on 2026-03-03, the most recent edit among the company pages checked apart from leadership, so the hiring push appears current rather than abandoned (https://menloeng.com/wp-json/wp/v2/pages?per_page=30&_fields=slug,modified,link)

No engineering-technician, administrative, billing, receptionist or marketing roles were posted at the time of review, only billable technical and management positions (https://menloeng.com/our-company/careers/)
review_themes: Public review volume is very small: three reviews, all 5.0, with the newest roughly eight years old and the oldest roughly twelve years old, so there is no current stream of client feedback (https://reviews.birdeye.com/menlo-engineering-associates-inc-144684430385065)

Google Maps shows a 5.0 rating for the Highland Park office but does not expose the review count in the limited view, so the rating rests on a handful of votes (https://www.google.com/maps/search/Menlo+Engineering+Associates+Highland+Park+NJ)

The only published testimonial is a short on-site quote from a developer client praising persistence and professionalism; the firm leans on that relationship story instead of review volume (https://menloeng.com/our-company/clients-testimonials/)

No complaints about responsiveness, billing, scheduling or quality were found in public sources; that is an absence of data rather than evidence of no problems (https://reviews.birdeye.com/menlo-engineering-associates-inc-144684430385065)
tech_footprint: WordPress site built on the Divi page builder (et_pb shortcodes throughout the pages), running All in One SEO 5.0.5 (https://menloeng.com/)
Forms are Gravity Forms 3.2.2 with reCAPTCHA v3; no CRM, chat widget, booking tool, client portal or payment path is present on any page checked (https://menloeng.com/contact-us/)
Google Analytics 4 is installed via gtag (measurement ID G-02HM33KMW5), so traffic is measured but no lead-scoring or chat pipeline follows it (https://menloeng.com/)

Structured data is Organization-only with name, telephone, logo and sameAs but no address, areaServed or services, while the Contact page carries the full postal address — the schema does not match the page content (https://menloeng.com/)

Page-builder shortcode breakage affects the Projects index, the News index, the Project Map container and the related-posts module on individual posts, leaving large parts of the site visually empty (https://menloeng.com/projects/)

The Google Map on the Contact page renders as an empty black panel at 390 px width, and the footer still reads '(c) 2024' plus a 'WordPress Web Design Agency' credit (https://menloeng.com/contact-us/)
growth_signals: Newest project announcement (June 26, 2026) covers a 281,215-SF Class A industrial facility at 169 Lackawanna Avenue, Parsippany, for Greek Real Estate Partners with completion anticipated in early 2027 (https://menloeng.com/congratulations-to-greek-real-estate-partners-on-169-lackawanna-avenue/)

Two simultaneous senior hires (a $75k-$90k designer and a $120K-$135K P.E. project manager) point to a fuller project backlog rather than replacement of a single seat (https://menloeng.com/our-company/careers/)

Firm is in the middle of a leadership transition: a new officer team was named with the founder-era principals moving to part-time advisory roles ahead of retirement (https://menloeng.com/menlo-engineering-proudly-announces-our-new-executive-team/)

Work continues through 2025-2026 municipal hearings, including a Riverdale Planning Board appearance by Scott Turner in November 2025 as the applicant's sworn expert (https://www.riverdalenj.gov/_Content/pdf/minutes/2025-11-13-PB-Minutes.pdf)
The firm was established in 1966, so 2026 is its 60th year — an anniversary with no corresponding promotion anywhere on the site (https://menloeng.com/our-company/)

Project case studies have not been added since July 2024 (latest 'project' post type entries), so new wins are not being converted into portfolio content (https://menloeng.com/wp-json/wp/v2/project?per_page=5&_fields=date,link,title)
physical_signals: Single stated office at 261 Cleveland Avenue, Highland Park, NJ 08904, with phone and fax lines, no other locations listed anywhere on the site (https://menloeng.com/contact-us/)

Office hours Monday-Friday 8:30 a.m.-5:00 p.m., closed weekends, i.e. a conventional weekday consultancy office with no published 24-hour desk (https://reviews.birdeye.com/menlo-engineering-associates-inc-144684430385065)

Team visible on the site: five named officers plus six named key personnel (project managers and a landscape architect), consistent with a small-to-mid consultancy (https://menloeng.com/our-company/our-leadership/)

Deliverables are project-scale engineering: a 281,215-SF industrial facility among current work, and a stated 3,000+ planning and design projects since 1966 (https://menloeng.com/congratulations-to-greek-real-estate-partners-on-169-lackawanna-avenue/)

Client roster covers retail chains, national homebuilders, banks, institutions and municipalities, indicating many concurrent sites and jurisdictions rather than a single campus (https://menloeng.com/our-company/clients-testimonials/)

Board testimony is delivered by named firm engineers in person at municipal meetings, i.e. staff time is committed to evening hearings (https://www.riverdalenj.gov/_Content/pdf/minutes/2025-11-13-PB-Minutes.pdf)
decision_maker: Gregory S. Oman, President / Principal Engineer — listed on the firm's Our Leadership page (https://menloeng.com/our-company/our-leadership/) and named President in the firm's own executive-team announcement (https://menloeng.com/menlo-engineering-proudly-announces-our-new-executive-team/). Scott Turner, Vice President / Principal Engineer, is the named resume contact on both current job postings (https://menloeng.com/our-company/careers/).

inferences.inference: Inquiries that arrive outside 8:30-5 on weekdays probably wait until the next business day, and nobody is measuring that gap.
inferences.reasoning: Published hours are weekday-only, the only contact paths are a phone line and a form with no auto-acknowledgement or booking, and no after-hours or emergency coverage is published anywhere on the site or listings.

inferences.inference: Each new project inquiry needs a human to qualify it before an engineer can respond.
inferences.reasoning: The contact form collects only Name, Email, Phone and Message, with no municipality, parcel, project type, timeline or file upload, so scope has to be extracted from free text.

inferences.inference: Sales and credibility suffer because current work is invisible on the firm's own site.
inferences.reasoning: A June 2026 project announcement exists as a post, but the News and Projects indexes render raw shortcode, the Project Map holds an empty iframe, and the newest portfolio entries date to July 2024.

inferences.inference: The firm has no systematic review-request process.
inferences.reasoning: Only three public reviews exist, the newest about eight years old, despite a 3,000-project history and a large named client roster.

inferences.inference: Hiring two senior engineers plus a dormant drafting posting signals backlog pressure in production and project management rather than a marketing problem alone.
inferences.reasoning: Both open roles are billable delivery roles with explicit CAD, stormwater and permitting requirements, and the careers page was refreshed in March 2026.

inferences.inference: Board-hearing logistics are a recurring coordination load that a scheduling or document agent could partly absorb.
inferences.reasoning: Firm engineers appear as sworn experts at municipal boards, each appearance requiring filing dates, exhibits and hearing calendars.

inferences.inference: The site is being maintained piecemeal by an outside designer rather than by an in-house owner.
inferences.reasoning: A few pages were edited in March-May 2026 while home and contact pages are unchanged since 2024, the footer credits a web design agency, and broken shortcodes have been left unresolved on three index pages.

data_gaps: LinkedIn, Indeed, BuildZoom, Mployer Advisor, Cylex and re-nj.com all returned Cloudflare or 403 blocks, so no verified headcount, job-posting history or permit history could be read; only unverified third-party snippets suggest 11-50 (LinkedIn) or 1-24 (Mployer Advisor) employees.
Google review count and review text were not visible in the limited Maps view; review volume is known only from the third-party listing (3 reviews).
The Contact page as rendered shows address, phone and fax but no office hours, contrary to the triage note that hours appear there; hours come only from the Google/Birdeye listing.
No negative reviews, complaints, BBB record or Glassdoor profile for this specific firm were found, so nothing can be said about service failures from customer voice.
Office square footage, headcount, revenue, fleet and software stack behind the website (CAD, PDF and project-management tools) are not publicly stated anywhere that could be opened.
The firm's own News page and project portfolio are non-functional, so the volume of 2025-2026 project wins cannot be counted from the site.
